name: posthog-js-slim
description: Subpath entry point for the tree-shakeable core bundle, the smallest way to load PostHog. It inlines no extension: session replay, surveys, exception autocapture and the rest come from posthog-js/extensions and are passed through the __extensionClasses config, so a bundler keeps out every extension the site does not pass. It still installs the external script loader; use posthog-js/slim/no-external when no script may be loaded. ESM-only, like the extension bundles it composes with; consumed by bundlers via the `module` field.
